# Specification - Clean Auxiliary Files generated by LaTeX/latexmk

## Overview
The goal of this track is to add clean-auxiliary tasks (`clean-aux` and `docker-clean-aux`) to the build system (`Taskfile.yml`). This enables removing intermediate LaTeX files (like `.aux`, `.log`, `.fls`, `.fdb_latexmk`, and `.out`) while keeping the compiled `.pdf` output files intact.

## Requirements
- Add a local task `clean-aux` that runs `latexmk -c` to clean up LaTeX auxiliary files.
- Add a Docker-based task `docker-clean-aux` that runs `latexmk -c` inside the `texlive/texlive` Docker container to perform the same cleanup without requiring a local LaTeX installation.
- Ensure that the compiled `.pdf` files are NOT deleted by these clean-aux tasks.
- Verify that both local and Docker compilation targets still work after running cleanup.
